reviews.classification: complete source/fixture/projection/continuation evidence record with explicit native and current-state limits
reviews.disposition:
The complete429-line owner and20-line evidence README were read, including CS1–CS9/CS6a–k, both design rounds, all21 review topics, WA50's mapping, the ladder contract and three later slice receipts. Gallery read toggles, one earned elder route and later own/opponent/People slices are distinct evidence windows. The initial bundle prefix does not cover later header wording or follow-up builds. Eight listed captures are not proof of every read, accessibility behavior, multi-seat app lifecycle or current main. The initial missing self/opponent/person-line integration is qualified by later named slices, while bio/abilities, an actual second opponent read, stored observation history and the blocked people_browser harness remain separately open.

**CS6b correction.** Original rationale: “A band is floored to its width (38 at width 5 reads ‘35 to 39’), so a band's midpoint never equals the truth.” The final implication is mathematically false: true37 also lies in35–39 and equals its midpoint. Fixed bands avoid centering every interval on the input; they do not guarantee the midpoint differs or prevent all possible inference. The live sentence is corrected without changing a band algorithm, API, runtime or test. No current implementation defect is inferred from this prose error.

The AP ladder, rank ceiling, schema/channel filters, merge priority and blanket guessed-divination policy are proposed means definitions. Actual reliable divination or a faculty that exceeds a ceiling follows its own supported mechanism; reliability is not universally capped by its label. Player native stats remain exact under AD8, while undiscovered hidden layers and other people's unknowns follow actual observer means. “Between you” is observer memory, not omniscient history. Exact values require a real source; guessed/stale/unknown should retain their basis, and hidden counts, foreign IDs or a scoped header must not leak unread truth. A midpoint or generic rank is not a universal power comparison across worlds.

The source's general-knowledge game comparisons are attributed unverified references, not fresh research. Pure rows and schema fields do not prove all later-volume mechanisms work without new code. Figure slots, optional composition, pop-outs, one-row animation, themed grids and suggested read notices are local UI choices; current [UI rules](../UI_RULES.md), [PROJECT](../../PROJECT.md), AD36/AD43 and AD42 govern actual selected work. Inspection itself need not have a cost if the means does not. Storing current reads, historical read times, world truth at chapter, player perception and a derived display are different owners. No source code, image, browser, test, source book, app install or personal save was newly inspected by this full-document review.

D28 reciprocal connection, the quiet faculty, paused A/B routes, optional repeat and import publication fix are bounded recorded delivery, not a general world/death/copy/portable-storage engine. Current broad worlds and lead-life work do not become restricted to this adapter.
